subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error.

The scientist made an __appauling__ discovery about the environmental impact of the drug.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appalling"** means causing shock or dismay; horrific. (डरावना)

 
 
• **Example:** The living conditions in the refugee camp were absolutely appalling.
 
 
 
• **"Appauling" **is the incorrect spelling of "appalling". (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist made an appauling discovery about the environmental impact of the drug.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apalling** (अपलिंग): This is also an incorrect spelling of "appalling".

 
 
• **Example:** The apalling state of the roads made travel difficult.
 
 
 
• **Appaulling** (अपाउलिंग): This is another incorrect spelling of "appalling".
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist made an appaulling discovery about the environmental impact of the drug.
 
 
 
• **Appawling** (अपाव्लिंग): Yet another incorrect spelling of "appalling".
 
 
• **Example:** The conditions in the factory were appawling.
 
 

35:T912,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
